subject: Sequencing MSA / DPA / Order Form — MAP and evaluation timeline for HelioMed
messages:

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & sequencing for evaluation and procurement

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We're ready to map out procurement and legal sequencing so we can start a two-week evaluation with a small footprint (1 GPU pool). Two asks from our side: 1) a clear mutual action plan (who signs what and when) and 2) whether the evaluation can start before the MSA is fully executed (we typically prefer a written MSA but can do a short trial with an NDA).

High level constraints: our security team needs SOC2 evidence and a DPA review; procurement needs a PO and standard 30-day net terms. Can you propose a timeline that shows MSA/DPA/Order Form dependencies and the earliest usable start date?

Happy to set a 30-minute call this week to align. I copied our external counsel (Samantha) who will be handling DPA redlines.

Best,
Aaron
Director, Product
HelioMed

Subject: Re: MAP & sequencing for evaluation and procurement

Aaron — thanks for the clear ask. I've drafted a short MAP and attached a first-pass timeline (see Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level proposal below so we can iterate quickly: 

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (now): Share MAP + Order Form template. HelioMed confirms legal & procurement contacts (Samantha + Aaron). 
- Week 1: HelioMed reviews DPA; Redwood provides SOC2_summary.pdf and answers security Qs. Legal back-and-forth limited to a single redline round where possible.
- Week 2: Execute MSA (signature) or, if HelioMed prefers, sign short NDA + trial Order Form for a limited evaluation window (30 days). DPA can be executed in parallel but MSA signature required before production provisioning.
- Week 3: Order Form signed + PO received -> Dedicated evaluation capacity provisioned (1 GPU pool). Evaluation kickoff and baseline perf tests.
- Week 4-6: Evaluation period + checkpoints (weekly syncs).

Dependencies and notes:
- MSA must be in place for any production-level provisioning; for evaluation we can do a controlled trial on our hosted environment with limited data and a signed evaluation Order Form.
- DPA review can and should run in parallel with MSA to avoid serial delays. If HelioMed submits redlines, please send them to me and Priyom so we can coordinate with legal.
- PO and billing terms are procurement items — Priyom will outline options below.

Target timeline: If we start this week and legal limits redlines to one round, target Order Form signing by 2026-03-30 and evaluation start on 2026-04-01. If you need the MSA first, shift everything ~1 week.

Next steps:
1) Aaron/Samantha: confirm whether you want to start under an NDA + evaluation Order Form or wait for the MSA.
2) Procurement: confirm PO cadence and billing contact.
3) We'll stand up a HubSpot deal and DocuSign envelope for the Order Form once we have confirmation.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + timeline), SOC2_summary.pdf (compliance summary), OrderForm_Template_Redwood.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a call Thursday morning if helpful.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Aaron / Olga — looping in procurement details so there is no confusion on billing and PO requirements. A few clarifying bullets from Redwood finance/procurement: 

- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears is our default for hosted evaluations; we can offer Net 30 for established enterprise deals (requires a credit check for new accounts).
- PO: We can accept a PO referencing the signed Order Form (preferred). Please include billing address and your internal vendor code if you have one.
- Taxes: we need your tax ID for invoicing where applicable.
- Trial credit: for a short proof-of-value we can issue a $5k evaluation credit applied to the first invoice if the Order Form is signed.

If you prefer to proceed under an NDA + Order Form to start the trial, we can provision on a limited basis once we receive the signed Order Form plus a PO or payment guarantee. For full dev/prod provisioning we require MSA + DPA signed first.

I'll attach a short checklist (Payment_Questions.md) with the exact fields we need from procurement.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: HelioMed DPA redlines and SOC2 request

Hi Olga / Aaron — I've attached our DPA redlines (HelioMed_DPA_Redlines.docx). A couple of quick points from legal: 

- We prefer to consolidate DPA comments into a single redline rather than multiple back-and-forths.
- Please confirm whether Redwood's data processing exhibits subprocessors and provide a current list or a link to your subprocessor policy.
- We will need your SOC2 type II report or a SOC2 summary (the latter is acceptable for the evaluation but we will request the full report before production).

If you can confirm Redwood's approach to data deletion at the end of the evaluation and whether logs are retained centrally, that would help expedite our internal signoff.

Best,
Samantha Liu

Aaron — following up to move this across the finish line. Per Olga and Priyom's notes, we prepared an evaluation Order Form that scopes a 30-day trial (1 GPU pool) and applies a $5k evaluation credit. I've put the document into DocuSign to make signature straightforward: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-HELIOMED

Two options (choose one):
1) NDA + Evaluation Order Form: sign the Order Form via DocuSign now and we'll provision limited evaluation capacity (no production access). DPA can be completed in parallel and MSA may follow for production. Target start date: 2026-04-01 if signed by 2026-03-30.
2) Full MSA + DPA + Order Form: sign all three documents for immediate production-ready provisioning. This path typically adds ~1 week depending on legal turnaround.

We included a short summary of what we need in the DocuSign cover note (billing contact, PO number if you want to use a PO, and a contact for technical onboarding). If you sign option 1 we'll schedule an onboarding session within 48 hours of provisioning.

Please let us know which option you prefer and if Samantha has any outstanding redlines that would block option 1. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the DocuSign steps.

Thanks,
